prompt.text:
Implement the following API.

File contract: Return solution.rs with the public function at module scope.
Required API: pub fn metric_rollup(input: &str) -> Option<String>
Behavior: Parse semicolon-separated key=amount records. Keys are non-empty lowercase ASCII identifiers with letters, digits, or interior hyphens; amounts are canonical non-negative decimals. Sum repeated keys with signed-64-bit overflow rejection and return sorted key=sum records joined by semicolons.
Visible example: cpu=2;mem=3;cpu=4 returns cpu=6;mem=3.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.

reference.code: use std::collections::BTreeMap;pub fn metric_rollup(input:&str)->Option<String>{let mut d:BTreeMap<&str,i64>=BTreeMap::new();for r in input.split(';'){let(p,v)=r.split_once('=')?;if p.split('-').any(|x|x.is_empty()||!x.bytes().all(|c|c.is_ascii_lowercase()||c.is_ascii_digit()))||!(v=="0"||!v.starts_with('0')&&!v.is_empty()&&v.bytes().all(|c|c.is_ascii_digit())){return None}let n:i64=v.parse().ok()?;let old=d.get(p).copied().unwrap_or(0);d.insert(p,old.checked_add(n)?);}Some(d.into_iter().map(|(k,v)|format!("{}={}",k,v)).collect::<Vec<_>>().join(";"))}
